To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the 55-m high steel tower of GAMESA G52 model wind turbine is not a stiff structure, and it can be considered as a soft structure.
the tower structure of 850 KW Gamesa wind turbine is safe for all the operating conditions of the wind turbine rotor.
the numerical modal analysis is an efficient and accurate tool for the modal parameters identification and the dynamic response of wind turbine tower.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the numerical modal analysis of the tower structure of the wind turbine.
the modal analysis of a wind turbine tower, and the results obtained are useful for the dynamic response and control of the wind turbine.
the numerical modal analysis of a real steel tower, which can be used to identify the modal parameters of the structure.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the tower structure is a very important part of the wind turbine.
the resonant problem of the tower structure can be avoided by the appropriate design of the controller of the wind turbine.
the resonant susceptible areas of the wind turbine steel tower structure are in the range of 25.9–30.8 rpm of the rotor.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the FE method is a very powerful tool for the modal analysis of the tower structure of a wind turbine.
, for the wind turbines with the rotor speed of more than 30.8 RPM, the stiff–stiff tower is not suitable and a soft–stiff tower should be used in order to avoid resonance.
the FE model is an accurate and efficient tool in the analysis of wind turbine tower structure.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the FE model can provide a reliable and efficient way to predict modal characteristics of wind turbine steel towers.
the modal parameters of the steel tower of wind turbine can be determined by the numerical modal analysis method.
the tower design should be based on the wind turbine controller design and vice versa.
